title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run calibration for all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette using the OT App; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Transfer reagents for PCR
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip for each transfer, dispense samples, primers, BigDye, and water into a clean PCR plate, accurately delivering volumes of 1–6 µL. Ensure that the number of samples multiplied by the number of primers does not exceed 96, otherwise the protocol will abort.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate volume of sample (1–6 µL).
Transfer the appropriate volume of primer (1–6 µL).
Transfer the appropriate volume of BigDye (1–6 µL).
Transfer the appropriate volume of water (1–6 µL).
